description: Paired bone niches, offset sealed sarcophagi, candle altar, carved rear memorial and chained sea lamps.
differences: Vanilla skeleton skull blocks represent ossuary bones; no hostile entity or loot mechanic.
Each sarcophagus skull rests on a full chiseled support block rather than floating above a lower slab.
Contained water only at perimeter; candle altar dry, complete memorial roof.
water_policy: DRY HABITABLE COMPARTMENT, contained wet aquarium planters and shallow pools; not a fully flooded ocean ruin. All route goals remain dry. Glass enclosure for deployment preparation, not certified deep-ocean pressure/oxygen safety.
